known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm confirmed by biopsy 1 year earlier

no relative afferent pupillary defect
mild subcapsular cataracts bilaterally
a small central scotoma in the left eye

hyperreflective bands in the inner nuclear layer consistent with paracentral acute middle maculopathy
bilateral vestibular schwannomas, a parasellar mass consistent with a meningioma, and a cervical extramedullary lesion
normal optic nerve contours and calcified lesions in the right temporal lobe
